candidates: When introducing a new I/O backend for trajectories, evaluate whether it can be implemented as a backend plugged into the common `Trajectory` class rather than added exclusively to `BundleTrajectory` or another separate trajectory class. The stated project goal is a single trajectory class with multiple pluggable backends; new backends that bypass that architecture increase long-term maintenance divergence.

When adding or improving features in `BundleTrajectory` (such as writing extra per-frame data) that are absent from the base `Trajectory` class, evaluate whether the feature should instead be placed in or shared with `Trajectory`. Avoid siloing useful trajectory functionality in only one of the trajectory classes, as the project aims to consolidate capabilities in one place.
